name: Passbolt
title: passbolt.com
shortDescription: Passbolt is an open source password manager designed for team collaboration. It allows teams to manage and share credentials securely, integrating features like end-to-end encryption and private keys. Ideal for IT companies, governments, and defense agencies, Passbolt can be self-hosted or cloud-hosted, ensuring full data ownership and easy setup. Example use case: A tech company uses Passbolt to streamline access management across multiple projects.
cons: Might require technical knowledge for setup
